name: HR / HCM
desc: Build an HR platform — a core HRIS with payroll, benefits, time, and the full talent lifecycle.
features:
## Core
- Core HRIS — single employee system of record, profiles, org charts
- Document management with e-signature
- Employee & manager self-service (web + mobile)
- Configurable approval workflows
- Full-service payroll — automated federal/state/local tax calc & filing, W-2/1099, direct deposit, garnishments
- Benefits administration — open enrollment, medical/dental/vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k), carrier EDI, ACA/COBRA
- Time, attendance & scheduling — clock in/out, PTO/leave accruals, overtime, shift scheduling, payroll sync
- Reporting & analytics
- Role-based security, audit trails & compliance (SOC 2)

## Talent lifecycle
- Applicant tracking (ATS) & recruiting
- Onboarding
- Performance reviews & goals
- Compensation management
- Learning management
- Succession & internal mobility

## Differentiators
- AI HR copilot — conversational assistant, AI job descriptions & candidate matching
- Turnover prediction & anomaly detection
- Skills-based talent intelligence & an internal opportunity marketplace
- Engagement & wellbeing surveys
